name: 1 Apr 1946

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 1269 (Holywood Urban District (Extension) Order, 1945 (confirmation))
references.note: 19 Oct 1945, page 241. Made 17 Oct 1945. In force: 1 Apr 1946. Confirms Down County Council's order extending Holywood UD south-east to an area bounded via the Knocknagoney townland boundary (schedule).

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 1270 (Carrickfergus Urban District (Extension) Order, 1945 (confirmation))
references.note: 26 Oct 1945, page 248. Made 20 Oct 1945. In force: 1 Apr 1946. Confirms Antrim County Council's order extending Carrickfergus UD. Read from the Gazette's OCR text; not yet checked against the printed page.

references.label: Census of Population of Northern Ireland 1951: Preliminary Report
references.note: Changes in administrative areas since 1937, Co. Antrim items (3)-(4) and Co. Down items (15)-(16) (1 Apr 1946).

references.label: Urban Districts Boundaries (Procedure) Order (Northern Ireland) 1936 (S.R. & O. 1936 No. 170)
references.note: Made 9 Dec 1936 by the Ministry of Home Affairs under section 24 of the Local Government Act (Northern Ireland) 1934: the local inquiry and public notices required before a county council could make an order altering or defining the boundary of an urban county district. The Holywood and Carrickfergus extension orders of 1945 recite compliance with it (Belfast Gazette, issues 1269 and 1270, Oct 1945).

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 1285 (Castlereagh Rural District (boundary alteration))
references.note: 8 Feb 1946, page 35. In force: 1 Apr 1946. District boundary altered: Rural District of Castlereagh; places named: Castlereagh Rural District, Holywood Urban District, Belfast, Dundonald, County Down; by Ministry of Health and Local Government; in force 1 April 1946; under Local Government Act (Northern Ireland), 1934.

references.label: Belfast Gazette issue 1287 (Larne Rural District (boundary alteration))
references.note: 19 Feb 1946, page 51. In force: 1 Apr 1946. District boundary altered: Rural District of Larne; places named: Larne Rural District, Carrickfergus Urban District, Glenarm, County Antrim; by Ministry of Home Affairs / Ministry of Health and Local Government; in force 1 April 1946; under Local Government Act (Northern Ireland), 1934.

notes: 1 Apr 1946 reuses the converted geometry from 1 Apr 1945.
